story.title: The Honest Mirror
story.logline: A woman buys a vintage mirror that only reflects the choices she refused to make, forcing her to confront her alternate lives.
story.twist: The mirror is not showing alternate universes, but the ghosts of people she killed by staying safe.
story.ending: Which version of me is staring back at you right now?

scenes.narration: My reflection just smiled at me, and I haven't moved a single muscle in my face.
scenes.visual_prompt: A 25-year-old woman with shoulder-length dark hair wearing an oversized green hoodie standing in a cramped, dusty NYC apartment bedroom, looking at a tall antique mirror with an ornate brass frame.
scenes.camera: Extreme close-up on her wide eyes, slowly pulling back to reveal the reflection mismatch.

scenes.narration: I bought this antique mirror for twenty bucks. The flea market guy warned me it had a bad attitude.
scenes.visual_prompt: A 25-year-old woman with shoulder-length dark hair wearing an oversized green hoodie, holding a damp cloth, wiping dust off the ornate brass frame of the antique mirror.
scenes.camera: Medium shot tracking her hand movement.

scenes.narration: In the glass, I am not wearing this ragged hoodie. I am wearing a pilot uniform, boarding a jet.
scenes.visual_prompt: A 25-year-old woman with shoulder-length dark hair wearing an oversized green hoodie, staring intensely as the mirror reflection shows her in a crisp airline pilot uniform smiling broadly.
scenes.camera: Over-the-shoulder shot focusing on the glass reflection.

scenes.narration: Ten years ago, I dropped out of flight school. The mirror remembers the girl who stayed brave.
scenes.visual_prompt: A 25-year-old woman with shoulder-length dark hair wearing an oversized green hoodie, pressing her bare palm against the cold surface of the antique mirror, looking heartbroken.
scenes.camera: Medium close-up, shallow depth of field.

scenes.narration: Every night, it shows me a different life. The art show in Paris. The cabin in the woods.
scenes.visual_prompt: A 25-year-old woman with shoulder-length dark hair wearing an oversized green hoodie, sitting on her bed in the dimly lit bedroom, watching the mirror shift to show a paint-splattered artist.
scenes.camera: Wide shot of the bedroom with the glowing mirror as the primary light source.

scenes.narration: Until tonight. The reflection isn't living out a dream. It's standing in an empty graveyard.
scenes.visual_prompt: A 25-year-old woman with shoulder-length dark hair wearing an oversized green hoodie, standing close to the antique mirror, her face pale as she looks at the dark, desolate graveyard in the glass.
scenes.camera: Push in slowly on the terrifying reflection.

scenes.narration: The pilot, the artist, the writer—none of them are moving. They are standing completely still, like statues.
scenes.visual_prompt: A 25-year-old woman with shoulder-length dark hair wearing an oversized green hoodie, watching the mirror closely, her breath fogging the corner of the glass.
scenes.camera: Tight close-up on her frightened face.

scenes.narration: Then I read the engraving on the tombstone in the reflection. It has my exact birthday on it.
scenes.visual_prompt: A 25-year-old woman with shoulder-length dark hair wearing an oversized green hoodie, squinting at the mirror as the reflection zooms in on a weathered stone grave marker.
scenes.camera: POV shot from her perspective looking into the glass.

scenes.narration: They aren't alternate lives. They are the versions of me I murdered by choosing safety.
scenes.visual_prompt: A 25-year-old woman with shoulder-length dark hair wearing an oversized green hoodie, backing away from the antique mirror in sheer terror, hands over her mouth.
scenes.camera: Wide shaky cam tracking her retreat.

scenes.narration: The glass is cracking now. And the dead girl in the pilot uniform is stepping out. Which version of me is staring back at you right now?
scenes.visual_prompt: A 25-year-old woman with shoulder-length dark hair wearing an oversized green hoodie, trapped against the wall as a hand emerges from the glass mirror.
scenes.camera: Extreme close-up on her terrified eye reflecting the hand, then fading to black.

caption.hook: It didn't show my future. It showed my victims.
caption.title: The Honest Mirror
caption.caption:
Safety felt like kindness until I saw the body count of my own caution. Every path not taken was a life I ended.

Would you dare to look?
